server._comment: No "cleartext": true. Setting it makes the CLI write android:usesCleartextTraffic="true" into the generated cordova shim manifest, which permits plaintext HTTP to every host on the internet so that a WebView can reach a Go core on 127.0.0.1. android/app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml grants exactly that loopback exemption and refuses the rest.

App._comment: Concord owns back itself (ConcordCorePlugin.setBackDepth), enabling its callback only while the web navigation stack has something to pop. Capacitor's handler intercepts unconditionally, which stops the system ever drawing the predictive back-to-home animation.
